name: robots/andy-xiong6__bipedal_locomotion_isaaclab
title: Pointfoot blind flat locomotion task (Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim)
intro: Pointfoot blind flat locomotion task (Isaac Lab / Isaac Sim), adapted from andy-xiong6/bipedal_locomotion_isaaclab. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
